items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和基于iPSC的药物发现研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾性综述，总结了从基础神经发育研究到再生医学转化的历程。关键内容包括：发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能；建立神经干细胞分离方法；开展脊髓损伤的临床前研究并推进至iPSC衍生神经干细胞移植的首次人体试验；在ALS中利用患者iPSC平台筛选出药物罗匹尼罗，并验证其与临床反应的相关性。文章强调未来再生治疗需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 这篇综述由该领域核心研究者撰写，系统梳理了从基础发现到临床转化的完整路径，特别是iPSC技术在ALS药物筛选中的成功应用（罗匹尼罗），为ALS研究者提供了宝贵的转化研究范式，并提示发育生物学与再生医学的交叉可能带来新突破。

aiRead.keyFinding: iPSC技术已成功应用于ALS药物筛选（罗匹尼罗），并推进至脊髓损伤细胞移植的首次人体试验。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注罗匹尼罗在ALS中的后续临床试验结果，以及iPSC衍生细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的长期安全性和有效性数据。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和基于iPSC的药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中RNA介导的调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，涵盖损伤病理生理学分析、分子干预，以及使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终促成了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台，用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了罗匹尼罗（Ropinirole）作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC衍生细胞移植治疗脊髓损伤的首次人体试验及ALS药物筛选的最新进展，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135例ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积也存在性别差异，且部分差异在调整体型等因素后仍存在。提示解读ALS患者的炎症和超声指标时需考虑性别和体型。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统评估ALS中常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声的性别差异，提示性别和体型可能影响这些指标的解读，为未来ALS生物标志物研究和临床试验分层设计提供重要参考。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积存在性别差异，部分差异在调整后仍显著。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法区分ALS特异性变化；横断面设计无法评估预后；单中心样本量有限。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注包含健康对照和纵向随访的研究，以确认这些性别差异是否与ALS疾病进展或预后相关。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。系统性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否持续存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入135例ALS患者。分析了常规炎症标志物（包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率（ESR））以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行性别间比较，并应用错误发现率（FDR）校正以处理多重检验。多变量线性回归分析调整了年龄、病程、体重指数（BMI）、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍显著不同，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析中关联不稳定。探索性二次分析显示，完全调整后女性患者在大腿抬高时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而被谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照，观察到的超声差异不能特异性地归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究，以阐明这些观察的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的ALS队列数据，揭示了性别和体型对常规炎症及超声指标的显著影响，具有直接的ALS临床转化价值。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.
items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用犬类退行性脊髓病（DM）模型，发现本体感觉通路（包括脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核和背根神经节）存在显著病理改变，并与早期共济失调症状相关。研究还发现，即使SOD1风险等位基因纯合，部分犬也未发病，提示其他因素参与疾病发生。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS感觉病理学研究的空白，提示本体感觉通路病变可能是ALS早期症状的重要基础，为理解SOD1相关ALS的发病机制提供了新视角，并可能为早期诊断和干预提供靶点。

aiRead.keyFinding: 在犬DM模型中，本体感觉通路（脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核、DRG）出现轴突病理和SOD1阳性包涵体积累，且与共济失调相关；部分SOD1纯合子犬未发病，提示其他因素影响疾病表达。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于犬模型，与人类ALS的关联需进一步验证；样本量可能有限；未明确其他影响因素的具体性质。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否揭示SOD1突变以外的影响因素，以及本体感觉病理在人类ALS患者中的验证情况。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病机制的机制尚不清楚。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS具有相似性，尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理是否与盆肢一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬的该通路的感觉系统组成部分，这些犬包括早期和晚期DM以及年龄匹配的对照组。该疾病的特征包括脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理，胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在盆肢感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理学，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中常被忽视的感觉通路病理，具有明确的ALS相关性，并提示SOD1突变之外的因素影响疾病表型，具有转化价值。

items.title: When algorithms speak first: The public health risk of consumer AI in ALS diagnosis.
items.summary: Consumer AI platforms are increasingly used by patients to interpret medical reports, including ENMG results for ALS. While AI shows promise in controlled clinical settings (e.g., stroke imaging, melanoma detection), consumer-facing tools often provide overconfident, context-free diagnostic assertions (e.g., 'definitive evidence of ALS'), leading to premature and potentially harmful life-altering decisions. To highlight the clinical, ethical, and regulatory risks of unregulated AI in ALS diagnosis and propose actionable solutions. We present a case of AI-mediated misdiagnosis, analyze the limitations of consumer-facing AI (lack of clinical context, longitudinal data, and specialist oversight), and discuss the "authority paradox" (patients trusting AI outputs over clinicians' nuanced assessments). We propose a structured 4-step clinical approach for managing AI-mediated self-diagnoses and urge regulators to classify such tools as high-risk under the EU AI Act. The uncritical adoption of consumer AI in ALS diagnosis represents a public health risk. Clinicians, regulators, and developers must collaborate to ensure AI serves patients safely and ethically.
items.titleZh: 当算法先开口：消费级AI在ALS诊断中的公共卫生风险
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章警告，患者使用消费级AI解读肌电图等检查结果，可能因AI给出过度自信且缺乏临床背景的“ALS明确证据”式结论，导致误诊和过早的重大决策。作者报告了一例AI误诊案例，指出消费级AI缺乏临床背景、纵向数据和专家监督，并提出了临床应对AI自我诊断的4步流程，同时呼吁监管机构将此类工具列为高风险。
items.insight: 这项研究提醒ALS研究者，AI工具在临床应用中可能带来新的误诊风险，尤其是在患者直接使用消费级AI解读检查结果时。它强调了在开发AI辅助诊断工具时，必须考虑临床背景和专家监督，并推动监管框架的完善，这对ALS精准诊断和患者安全具有重要警示意义。

items.abstractZh: 消费级AI平台越来越多地被患者用于解读医学报告，包括ALS的肌电图（ENMG）结果。虽然AI在受控临床环境中显示出潜力（如卒中影像、黑色素瘤检测），但面向消费者的工具往往提供过度自信、脱离上下文的诊断断言（例如“ALS的明确证据”），导致过早且可能有害的重大决策。本文旨在强调无监管AI在ALS诊断中的临床、伦理和监管风险，并提出可行的解决方案。我们报告了一例AI介导的误诊案例，分析了消费级AI的局限性（缺乏临床背景、纵向数据和专科医生监督），并讨论了“权威悖论”（患者信任AI输出胜过临床医生的细致评估）。我们提出了一种结构化的4步临床方法来管理AI介导的自我诊断，并敦促监管机构根据欧盟AI法案将此类工具归类为高风险。在ALS诊断中不加批判地采用消费级AI构成公共卫生风险。临床医生、监管机构和开发者必须合作，确保AI安全、合乎伦理地为患者服务。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究聚焦于2026年新近出现的消费级AI在ALS诊断中的误用风险，直接关联ALS诊断的转化应用，并提出了监管和临床应对策略，具有前沿性和紧迫性。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.
items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46名SOD1-ALS患者接受Tofersen治疗，12个月后功能衰退速度减缓（ALSFRS-R进展率从0.53降至0.22点/月），血液NfL水平显著下降（从89降至29 pg/ml）。与历史队列相比，生存期延长（42.6 vs 31.8个月），死亡风险降低66%。但回顾性设计及ALSFRS-R敏感性存在局限。
items.insight: 这是首个大规模多中心真实世界研究，证实Tofersen在法国临床实践中对SOD1-ALS患者具有减缓功能衰退和降低NfL的效应，并提示生存获益，为ASO疗法在ALS中的应用提供了关键真实世界证据。

aiRead.studyType: 多中心回顾性队列研究（含历史对照）
aiRead.keyFinding: Tofersen治疗12个月显著减缓ALSFRS-R进展率并降低血浆NfL水平，且与历史队列相比延长生存期、降低死亡风险。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计、非随机对照、ALSFRS-R敏感性有限、历史队列可能存在选择偏倚。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Tofersen的长期疗效和安全性数据，以及其在SOD1-ALS早期或症状前患者中的应用效果。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALSFRS-R进展率从基线的0.53±0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22±0.3点/月（P=0.006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0±9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2±19.5 pg/ml（P=0.004）。与倾向评分匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P=0.30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P=0.006）。倾向评分匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P=0.004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P=0.03）。Tofersen似乎与功能衰退减缓及NfL水平降低相关。尽管需承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，这些发现提供了支持Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新真实世界数据，直接验证了靶向SOD1的ASO疗法在临床实践中的转化价值，对ALS精准治疗具有直接指导意义。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.
items.evidenceLevel: 综述（基于临床和实验研究）
items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了肠道微生物群通过肠-脑轴影响大脑健康的证据，指出不同神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）存在特定的微生物特征，并讨论了益生菌、粪菌移植等干预策略的潜力，但强调目前多数机制证据来自动物模型，临床转化仍面临挑战。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究者提供了肠-脑轴在神经退行性疾病中作用的系统梳理，提示ALS可能具有独特的微生物组特征，并指出靶向微生物群的干预策略（如粪菌移植）在临床前研究中显示出前景，值得关注后续的临床验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: 肠道微生物群通过多种机制影响CNS稳态，不同神经退行性疾病（包括ALS）存在疾病特异性的微生物特征，微生物靶向干预在临床前和早期临床研究中显示出潜力。
aiRead.limitation: 综述中引用的许多机制证据来自动物模型，人类研究有限；且研究人群和方法异质性大，限制了结论的普适性。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注针对ALS的纵向微生物组研究以及粪菌移植或代谢产物靶向治疗的随机对照试验结果。

items.abstractZh: 微生物群-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制连接胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，许多机制性观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了关于肠道微生物群在维持CNS稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经系统通讯，以及具有生物活性的微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验研究均报告了在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中的疾病特异性微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪菌移植和针对微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中取得了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案中的显著异质性继续限制着这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总体而言，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的有价值框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的肠-脑轴研究证据，并明确将ALS列为具有疾病特异性微生物特征的疾病之一，为ALS的微生物组靶向治疗提供了转化方向。

items.title: The Anterior Belly of the Digastric Muscle as a Novel Target for Needle Electromyography in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Needle electromyography (EMG) in the bulbar region aids in the diagnosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) but remains technically challenging. The genioglossus muscle (GM) is commonly examined; however, pain and poor relaxation may limit its evaluation. The trapezius is an alternative target but is innervated by the spinal accessory nerve. We investigated the utility of the anterior belly of the digastric muscle (ABDM), innervated by the trigeminal nerve, for bulbar EMG evaluation. In this unblinded, prospective observational study, consecutive patients with suspected ALS underwent needle EMG of the ABDM, GM, masseter muscle (MM), and trapezius. Relaxation levels, EMG abnormalities, and pain (100-mm visual analog scale [VAS]) were assessed. Twenty-seven clinically diagnosed ALS patients were analyzed. Relaxation was better in the ABDM than in the GM (p < 0.001) and comparable to that in the MM and trapezius. Fasciculation potentials were detected more often in the ABDM (52%) than in the GM (0%) and MM (22%; p = 0.039) and were comparable to the trapezius (59%). Chronic denervation occurred at similar frequencies across muscles (33%-59%). The combination of abnormal spontaneous activity and chronic denervation was most frequent in the ABDM (37%). Pain was lower with the ABDM (median VAS score of 21) than with the GM (28; p = 0.0052) and MM (32; p < 0.001) and was similar to the trapezius (23). The ABDM may be a practical additional target for bulbar EMG in ALS, with favorable relaxation, lower pain, and potentially improved electrodiagnostic yield.
items.titleZh: 二腹肌前腹作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症针极肌电图检查的新靶点
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了二腹肌前腹（ABDM）作为ALS球部肌电图检查新靶点的可行性。结果显示，与传统的颏舌肌相比，ABDM在患者放松程度和疼痛控制方面表现更优，且束颤电位检出率更高（52% vs 0%），与斜方肌相当。ABDM可能成为球部EMG的实用补充靶点，有助于提高诊断效率。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS球部肌电图检查提供了新的肌肉靶点，可能改善患者耐受性和诊断阳性率，对早期诊断和临床试验中的电生理评估具有潜在价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 二腹肌前腹在ALS患者中表现出更好的放松程度、更低的疼痛和较高的束颤电位检出率，可能作为球部EMG的实用靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（27例），且为非盲设计，可能引入偏倚；未与健康对照组比较。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究应验证ABDM在更大样本中的诊断准确性，并探索其与疾病进展和预后的关联。

items.abstractZh: 球部区域的针极肌电图（EMG）有助于肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的诊断，但在技术上仍具挑战性。颏舌肌（GM）是常用的检查部位，但疼痛和放松不良可能限制其评估。斜方肌是替代靶点，但由副神经支配。我们研究了由三叉神经支配的二腹肌前腹（ABDM）在球部EMG评估中的效用。在这项非盲、前瞻性观察性研究中，连续纳入疑似ALS患者，对ABDM、GM、咬肌（MM）和斜方肌进行针极EMG检查。评估放松程度、EMG异常和疼痛（100毫米视觉模拟量表[VAS]）。分析了27例临床确诊的ALS患者。ABDM的放松程度优于GM（p < 0.001），与MM和斜方肌相当。ABDM的束颤电位检出率（52%）高于GM（0%）和MM（22%；p = 0.039），与斜方肌（59%）相当。慢性失神经在各肌肉中的发生率相似（33%-59%）。异常自发电活动与慢性失神经的组合在ABDM中最常见（37%）。ABDM的疼痛评分（中位VAS 21）低于GM（28；p = 0.0052）和MM（32；p < 0.001），与斜方肌（23）相似。ABDM可能作为ALS球部EMG的实用附加靶点，具有较好的放松程度、较低的疼痛和潜在更高的电诊断阳性率。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提出了一种新的球部EMG靶点，具有近期临床转化价值，可能优化ALS诊断流程。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.
items.titleZh: ALS患者中巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，ALS患者体内针对绿藻病毒ATCV-1的抗体水平显著高于健康对照，且该病毒能优先感染促炎型M1巨噬细胞，增强炎症因子（如IL-6）并抑制抗炎因子（如IL-10）的产生。这提示ATCV-1感染可能通过加剧神经炎症参与ALS的病理过程。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS的病毒感染假说提供了新证据，表明口腔微生物组中的ATCV-1可能通过调节巨噬细胞极化状态影响疾病进展，为未来开发抗病毒或免疫调节策略提供了潜在靶点。

aiRead.studyType: 观察性临床研究结合体外细胞实验
aiRead.keyFinding: ALS患者中ATCV-1抗体水平升高，且ATCV-1优先感染M1巨噬细胞并促进炎症反应。
aiRead.limitation: 研究为观察性设计，未直接证明ATCV-1导致ALS；体外实验结果可能不能完全反映体内情况。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否验证ATCV-1在ALS患者中的直接致病作用，以及抗病毒治疗或免疫调节干预在ALS模型中的效果。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1)是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究表明，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。此外，与健康对照相比，ALS患者血清中针对ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著升高，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液，再次证实ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究人员使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别用ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1细胞的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1细胞。ATCV-1的MCP聚糖抑制了M1 THP-1细胞初始高水平的ISRE启动子活性。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1细胞在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1细胞本身高水平的IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步升高。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1细胞产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中针对ATCV-1的抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病的发展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合了临床样本（ALS患者血清/脑脊液）和体外巨噬细胞模型，揭示了特定病毒（ATCV-1）与ALS免疫失调之间的关联，具有转化价值。

items.title: Impact of Sexuality in Patients With Motor Neuron Disease.
items.summary: Sexuality is a relevant yet understudied aspect in people living with motor neuron disease (MND). This study aimed to assess whether sexuality in people with MND is influenced by motor, cognitive, behavioral, or mood disturbances, and to explore whether being sexually active impacts caregiver burden. We conducted a cross-sectional observational study involving participants with MND and their primary caregivers from three ALS multidisciplinary units in Seville, Spain. Data were collected between October 2018 and July 2021. Functional, cognitive, behavioral, and mood assessments were conducted. Sexuality was evaluated through sex-specific questionnaires. Caregiver burden was assessed using the Zarit Burden Interview. Among 66 participants who completed the sexuality assessment, 42.9% reported sexual activity in the previous month. Of these, 70% had no sexual dysfunction, while 26.7% had moderate and 3.3% severe dysfunction. No correlation was found between sexual activity and motor function. Sexual activity was less frequent in participants with apathy (p = 0.026), depression (p = 0.021), and frontotemporal dementia (p = 0.013). Among sexually active patients, those with cognitive impairment-particularly memory dysfunction-had higher rates of orgasm difficulties (p = 0.019). No other clinical parameters were related to sexuality. Sexuality of participants with MND did not influence caregiver burden. Sexuality in MND is more associated with cognitive and mood factors than with motor disability. Addressing sexuality in clinical practice may contribute to improving quality of life and should be integrated into the multidisciplinary care of MND patients.
items.titleZh: 性功能对运动神经元病患者的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项来自西班牙的横断面研究调查了66名MND患者的性功能状况。约43%的患者在过去一个月内有性生活，其中多数无性功能障碍。研究发现，性活动与运动功能无关，但与情感淡漠、抑郁和额颞叶痴呆显著相关；认知障碍（特别是记忆问题）与性高潮困难相关。性功能不影响照护者负担。作者建议将性问题纳入MND多学科照护。
items.insight: 这项研究填补了ALS/MND照护中常被忽视的性健康领域空白，提示临床医生应关注患者的认知和情绪状态对性功能的影响，而非仅关注运动功能，为多学科照护提供了新的切入点。

aiRead.keyFinding: MND患者的性功能与认知和情绪因素（情感淡漠、抑郁、额颞叶痴呆、记忆障碍）相关，而非运动功能；性功能不影响照护者负担。
aiRead.limitation: 样本量较小（66人），单中心（西班牙塞维利亚三个单元），可能存在选择偏倚；性功能评估依赖自我报告。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否有纵向研究探讨性功能随时间的变化及其与疾病进展的关系，以及干预措施（如心理咨询）对改善性功能和生活质量的效果。

items.abstractZh: 性功能是运动神经元病（MND）患者生活中一个相关但研究不足的方面。本研究旨在评估MND患者的性功能是否受运动、认知、行为或情绪障碍的影响，并探讨性生活活跃是否影响照护者负担。我们进行了一项横断面观察性研究，纳入来自西班牙塞维利亚三个ALS多学科单元的MND患者及其主要照护者。数据收集于2018年10月至2021年7月间。研究进行了功能、认知、行为和情绪评估。性功能通过性别特异性问卷进行评估。照护者负担使用Zarit负担访谈量表进行评估。在完成性功能评估的66名参与者中，42.9%报告在过去一个月内有性生活。其中，70%无性功能障碍，26.7%有中度功能障碍，3.3%有重度功能障碍。未发现性活动与运动功能之间存在相关性。存在情感淡漠（p=0.026）、抑郁（p=0.021）和额颞叶痴呆（p=0.013）的参与者性活动频率较低。在性生活活跃的患者中，存在认知障碍（尤其是记忆功能障碍）者达到性高潮困难的比率更高（p=0.019）。其他临床参数与性功能无关。MND参与者的性功能不影响照护者负担。MND中的性功能更多与认知和情绪因素相关，而非运动残疾。在临床实践中处理性问题可能有助于改善生活质量，应将其纳入MND患者的多学科照护中。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型美国退伍军人队列研究发现，不同军种和军衔的ALS发病率存在显著差异。空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役时间越长风险反而越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中尤为明显。
items.insight: 该研究基于超过900万退伍军人的大规模纵向数据，首次系统描绘了军种和军衔层面的ALS风险差异，为缩小军事相关ALS风险因素的范围提供了关键线索，对理解环境暴露在ALS发病中的作用具有重要价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 美国退伍军人中，空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役及军官身份与更高的ALS发病率相关，且年轻退伍军人中的差异更显著。

items.abstractZh: 军事服役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）发生最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服役的哪些方面重要，目前知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国（US）军种和军衔与偶发ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低的发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在按年龄分层的模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51）中最大，在年长男性（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）中最小。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而异，年轻退伍军人中的差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境中。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用近25年的大规模退伍军人队列数据，揭示了军种和军衔这一此前未被细化的ALS风险维度，具有直接的ALS病因学转化价值。

items.title: Incidence and clinical characteristics of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis during the post-COVID-19 Period: a population-based study from Isfahan, Iran.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder. Understanding the underlying causes would help further studies on the pathogenesis and treatments. Recent interest has emerged in evaluating whether the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccination have any influence on the epidemiological patterns of ALS. To assess this association in Isfahan, Iran, during the post-COVID-19 era, we conducted this retrospective study. Newly diagnosed ALS cases were identified, and demographic data, environmental exposures, comorbidities, vaccination history, and other aspects were collected. A total of 63 patients were diagnosed with definite ALS, yielding an incidence rate of 0.74 per 100,000 person-years (95% CI: 0.57-0.94). The mean age was 59.7 ± 11.6 years, and cases were predominantly male (73%). Of the 63 new ALS-diagnosed cases, 45% of patients reported probable prior COVID-19 infection, and 95.3% mentioned at least one dose of COVID-19 vaccination. Bulbar signs, including facial muscle weakness, tongue atrophy, and fasciculation, were present in 46% of cases, and emotional lability and cognitive decline were observed in 20.6%. We showed a probable relation between COVID-19 infection and the epidemiology of ALS in post-COVID era. However, our results and symptom alterations require further investigation. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a rare and serious disease that causes the nerve cells controlling movement to gradually stop working. Because ALS has no cure, understanding when and how it appears in the community is important for improving care and planning future research.Since the COVID-19 pandemic affected many body systems, including the brain and immune system, some people have wondered whether COVID-19 infection or vaccination might influence the development of ALS. To explore this question, we studied all new ALS cases diagnosed in Isfahan Province, Iran, between May 2023 and December 2024. This is the first study to examine ALS patterns in this region after the pandemic.We identified 63 new patients with definite ALS. The number of new cases was higher than the rate reported in Isfahan before the pandemic, suggesting that COVID-19 changed how often ALS occurs in this population. Almost half of the patients reported a previous COVID-19 infection, and most had received at least one COVID-19 vaccine dose, which reflects the high vaccination rate in the general population. We did not find evidence that infection or vaccination affected the type or severity of ALS symptoms.However, many patients showed bulbar symptoms (such as speech or swallowing problems) and some had cognitive changes at diagnosis, which highlights the need for early evaluation and support.Overall, our findings show that ALS patterns in Isfahan have changed after the COVID-19 pandemic, and continued monitoring is important.
items.titleZh: COVID-19 后时期肌萎缩侧索硬化症的发病率和临床特征：伊朗伊斯法罕的一项基于人群的研究
items.summaryZh: 这项来自伊朗伊斯法罕的基于人群的研究发现，COVID-19 大流行后（2023年5月至2024年12月）新诊断的 ALS 发病率（0.74/10万人年）高于疫情前该地区的报告值。约半数患者报告曾感染 COVID-19，但未发现感染或疫苗接种影响 ALS 症状类型或严重程度的证据。值得注意的是，46% 的患者在诊断时即有延髓症状，20.6% 伴有认知或情绪改变，提示需要早期评估和支持。
items.insight: 这是首个在 COVID-19 大流行后评估中东地区 ALS 流行病学变化的研究，其发病率上升的发现可能提示感染后免疫或炎症机制参与 ALS 发病，值得 ALS 研究者关注以探索潜在的环境触发因素。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病。了解其潜在病因有助于进一步研究其发病机制和治疗方法。近期，人们开始关注 COVID-19 大流行和疫苗接种是否会影响 ALS 的流行病学模式。为了评估这种关联，我们在伊朗伊斯法罕进行了一项回顾性研究，收集了 COVID-19 后时期新诊断的 ALS 病例的人口统计学数据、环境暴露、合并症、疫苗接种史等信息。共确诊 63 例明确 ALS 患者，发病率为 0.74/10 万人年（95% CI: 0.57-0.94）。平均年龄 59.7±11.6 岁，男性占 73%。其中 45% 的患者报告可能曾感染 COVID-19，95.3% 至少接种过一剂 COVID-19 疫苗。46% 的病例出现延髓体征（包括面部肌肉无力、舌萎缩和肌束颤动），20.6% 出现情绪不稳和认知功能下降。我们提示 COVID-19 感染与 COVID-19 后时期 ALS 的流行病学可能存在关联，但结果和症状变化仍需进一步研究。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于 COVID-19 大流行后的最新人群数据，首次报告了中东地区 ALS 发病率变化，具有新近性和 ALS 相关性。

items.title: The UNC13A cryptic exon associates with cognitive impairment in Alzheimer's disease.
items.summary: TAR DNA-binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43) is often found in the brains of patients with Alzheimer's disease (AD), where it co-occurs with amyloid β plaques and tau neurofibrillary tangles, and associates with accelerated cognitive decline and brain atrophy. TDP-43's function of repressing the inclusion of cryptic exons (CEs) during RNA splicing is compromised in AD. A single-nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) located within the CE in the UNC13A gene [rs12973192 (C > G)] is associated with higher disease risk and reduced survival in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and frontotemporal dementia (FTD) by weakening TDP-43 binding promoting CE inclusion. To investigate the influence of the rs12973192 UNC13A CE SNP and UNC13A cryptic splicing on TDP-43 pathology, survival and cognitive impairment in AD. We evaluated the UNC13A CE SNP in a cohort of 1,672 AD, including 643 AD brains with available cognitive measurements and 73 AD cases for which we measured cryptic RNA levels in the amygdala. We also evaluated a cohort of 466,517 from the UK Biobank to determine associations between the UNC13A CE SNP and dementia diagnosis. In AD, the UNC13A CE SNP associated significantly with cognitive decline, but not with TDP-43 pathology or with survival. UNC13A cryptic RNA levels in the amygdala were a better predictor of cognitive decline than the UNC13A CE SNP itself, while STMN2-another well-known CE target-exhibited no such association. These findings point to UNC13A cryptic splicing as a specific driver of cognitive decline in AD, outperforming both genetic risk and other cryptic targets.
items.titleZh: UNC13A 隐蔽外显子与阿尔茨海默病认知障碍相关
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，UNC13A 基因中的隐蔽外显子剪接变异（rs12973192）与阿尔茨海默病患者的认知衰退显著相关，且 UNC13A 隐蔽 RNA 水平比基因变异本身更能预测认知下降。该效应在 TDP-43 病理和生存方面未观察到，提示 UNC13A 隐蔽剪接可能是 AD 认知障碍的特异性机制。
items.insight: 该研究将 ALS/FTD 中已知的 UNC13A 隐蔽外显子机制扩展到阿尔茨海默病，提示 UNC13A 隐蔽剪接可能是跨神经退行性疾病的共同病理通路，对 ALS 研究具有重要参考价值，因为 UNC13A 变异在 ALS 中同样影响疾病风险和进展。

items.abstractZh: TAR DNA 结合蛋白 43 kDa（TDP-43）常见于阿尔茨海默病（AD）患者脑内，与淀粉样 β 斑块和 tau 神经原纤维缠结共存，并与加速的认知衰退和脑萎缩相关。在 AD 中，TDP-43 在 RNA 剪接过程中抑制隐蔽外显子（CE）包含的功能受损。UNC13A 基因 CE 内的单核苷酸多态性（SNP）[rs12973192 (C > G)] 通过削弱 TDP-43 结合并促进 CE 包含，与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和额颞叶痴呆（FTD）的更高疾病风险和更短生存期相关。本研究旨在探讨 rs12973192 UNC13A CE SNP 和 UNC13A 隐蔽剪接对 AD 中 TDP-43 病理、生存和认知障碍的影响。我们在 1,672 例 AD 队列中评估了 UNC13A CE SNP，其中包括 643 例具有可用认知测量的 AD 脑样本和 73 例我们测量了杏仁核中隐蔽 RNA 水平的 AD 病例。我们还评估了来自英国生物银行的 466,517 人队列，以确定 UNC13A CE SNP 与痴呆诊断之间的关联。在 AD 中，UNC13A CE SNP 与认知衰退显著相关，但与 TDP-43 病理或生存无关。杏仁核中 UNC13A 隐蔽 RNA 水平比 UNC13A CE SNP 本身更能预测认知衰退，而 STMN2（另一个众所周知的 CE 靶标）则没有这种关联。这些发现表明 UNC13A 隐蔽剪接是 AD 认知衰退的特定驱动因素，其表现优于遗传风险和其他的隐蔽靶标。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于 2026 年，首次在大型 AD 队列中证实 UNC13A 隐蔽剪接与认知衰退的关联，并优于遗传风险，具有跨疾病转化价值。

items.title: Prescribing and monitoring of riluzole in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cohort study from Health New Zealand - Te Whatu Ora Waitaha Canterbury.
items.summary: This retrospective cohort study assessed adherence to the Motor Neurone Disease New Zealand best practice guidelines and Pharmac Special Authority criteria for riluzole in a Canterbury-based amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) cohort. Secondary objectives included reasons for not prescribing, side effects and treatment initiation relative to diagnosis. A retrospective cohort study was conducted using the Christchurch Hospital respiratory department's ALS database. Patients diagnosed between January 2020 and November 2024 were included. Electronic health records and Special Authority records were reviewed. Patients with incomplete data or non-motor neurone disease (MND) diagnoses were excluded. Of 115 patients, 69 (60%) were prescribed riluzole. Less than 45% of patients had baseline blood tests, and pre-treatment spirometry was completed in 70% of patients. Delays in prescribing improved rates of baseline spirometry, but not blood test completion. Ongoing monitoring was poor, with less than 60% of patients completing recommended tests across all time points. Eight patients (11.6%) reported side effects, and three discontinued treatment following alanine aminotransferase derangement. Adherence to recommended monitoring and Special Authority criteria for riluzole was inconsistent in this cohort. In the context of emerging evidence supporting broader survival benefit and reduced drug cost, further evaluation of current Special Authority prescribing criteria may be warranted.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中利鲁唑的处方与监测：新西兰健康局坎特伯雷地区回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 新西兰坎特伯雷地区的一项回顾性研究显示，ALS患者中利鲁唑的处方率仅为60%，且基线血液检查和治疗前肺功能检查的完成率不理想（分别低于45%和70%），后续监测也不足。约12%的患者出现副作用，少数因肝酶异常停药。研究提示，当前处方标准可能过于严格，需重新评估。
items.insight: 这项研究揭示了真实世界中利鲁唑处方和监测的依从性问题，尤其是在新西兰特别授权标准下，可能限制了患者获得治疗的机会。随着利鲁唑生存获益证据的更新和成本降低，该研究为优化处方政策提供了数据支持，对ALS临床实践和卫生政策制定具有直接参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 利鲁唑处方率仅60%，基线检查和监测依从性差，但处方延迟与基线肺功能检查率提高相关。
